core_philosophy: Premium, modern, border-free design language. Therapeutic, professional, and calming. No hard borders, rely on subtle elegant drop shadows and generous whitespace.

styling_rules.borders: NO hard borders. Remove 'border' and 'border-border' from standard components. Use shadow-sm or custom soft shadows.
styling_rules.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 for main cards. py-4 for list items.
styling_rules.icons: Use lucide-react. Keep stroke-width to 1.5 or 2 for a refined look.

components.greeting_header: Show 'Good Evening, Dr. <Name> 👋' and a subtitle (e.g., 'Here is what your day looks like.'). Include existing search bar and Quick Actions cluster.
components.alert_pills: Small muted badges (e.g., rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-2) for 'Low stock' and 'Ready for pickup'.
components.kpi_cards: 5 top-row cards. Active metrics use 'kpi_active_mint' or 'kpi_active_blue'. Zero-value metrics use 'kpi_muted'. Include small sparklines or trend indicators if applicable.
components.calendar_empty_state: Left column block. Elegant, soft design. Use a large, soft-colored lucide-react icon (like CalendarHeart or Calendar) with a therapeutic message 'No appointments today'.
components.patient_list: Right column. 'Recent Registrations' borderless list. Avatar + Name, Age + Gender, Tag (New/Returning), Phone, Date. Ample vertical line-height. CTA '+ New Registration' top right.
components.quick_actions: 3-4 buttons. Use soft background colors or ghost button styles to avoid cluttering the primary hierarchy.

mockups_instructions.deliverable: Provide 3 distinct full-page mockups (implement as 3 separate layout components or a toggleable layout in the dashboard). All must apply the off-white bg, no hard borders, 12px radius, pastel fills, and Inter typography.
mockups_instructions.Mock_A: Magazine Grid: 5 stacked KPI cards across the top in a single row. Below it, a strict 50/50 split with Calendar on the left and Patient List on the right.
mockups_instructions.Mock_B: Hero + Sidebar: Asymmetric KPI strip (1 large primary KPI tile spanning 2 columns, 4 smaller tiles). Below it, a 2-column main body (Calendar/Patients) and a slim right-rail for 'Today's Schedule' timeline.
mockups_instructions.Mock_C: Workspace Cards: 12-column grid layout. Every region (KPIs, Calendar, Patients, Quick Actions) is an elevated panel with clear visual hierarchy and breathing room, arranged in a masonry or bento-box style.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are editing /app/frontend/src/modules/patients/ModernDashboard.jsx (or creating new files alongside it for layout variations).
Replace existing hard borders with elegant drop shadows and border-radius 12px.
Apply background color #F8F9FA to the main content area.
Implement the 3 layouts (Mock A, B, C). You can create 3 separate components and render them stacked or with a toggle to present them to the user.
Preserve all existing data points and functionalities mentioned in the prompt (Search, Greeting, KPI counts, Lists).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
